conclusion.alternative_approach: Cite published results and discuss methodological differences in Limitations section

recommendation: Document in Limitations that CL-DTA methods (CSCo-DTA, GraphCL-DTA) were not reproduced due to code unavailability. Cite their published results for comparison. This is a common practice in benchmark studies when baseline methods are not open-source.
